strategy_improvements: Stable auditable kernel with an explicitly experimental adapter and agent edge.
One application facade with machine-readable CLI/MCP parity.
Record-report-study graph and immutable living-review lineage.
Versioned standards packs that separate reporting from methodological conduct.
Provenance, accessibility, governance and assurance as architectural concerns.
Evidence-scaled tracks that never equate source implementation with runtime or external proof.
CiteWeft provides optional source-grounded document evidence without contaminating the search kernel or canonical CSL.
Pinned integration passports and consumer-driven contracts replace undocumented cross-repository coupling.
Conductor tracks map deterministically to GitHub issues and each plan phase maps to a native subissue.
A canonical context spine, claim boundaries and hazard ledger constrain all coding-agent surfaces.
Every top-level Conductor task maps to a native nested GitHub subissue and every generated issue maps to a declarative Project v2 item.
Repository settings, protected environments, security controls, branch rules and Project fields are managed by an idempotent dry-run-first control plane.
Maturity now includes cross-repository release trains, operational reliability, authenticated tenancy, generated SDK boundaries, staged pilots and a final release decision.
Telemetry is disabled by default; backups, restore, incidents and remote access are explicit versioned contracts rather than deployment assumptions.
Assertion-level traceability separates implementation completeness from evidence level and deliberately downgrades incomplete tracks.
